name: Word-Scapes
author: Addicting Games
description: Word-Scapes is a free word game. Crosswords is a classic word game where players combine words and overlap each other in order to complete a puzzle. It is an age-old game that has finally been upgraded. In Word-Scapes, you'll be tasked with filling out a grid of crossing words. The trick here is that you'll also have a selection of letters at the bottom of the screen. In order to fill out the grid, you must first connect the letters to form words. The formed words will automatically appear in the grid as long as you correctly identify and link the letters. The added challenge of finding letters in a soup of chaos makes this game all the more fun.
